name: Calvary Crossroads

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large single-story commercial building with multiple connected sections|A large paved parking lot surrounds the building on three sides|Mature trees and landscaping are present along the perimeter, with open paved areas dominating the site

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main entrance area with a large paved parking lot in front|The building has multiple roof sections and visible entry points|Trees and landscaping line portions of the front perimeter

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows parking spaces and an access lanes|Mature trees and landscaping are visible along this side|Windows spread across the entire length of this side of the building

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows parking areas and landscaping present|Windows flank the entirety of the rear of the building, as well as a recessed, covered entry point

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows parking spaces and access|Mature trees frame portions of this side, with paved areas extending around the structure|The facility is bordered on this side with a fence.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple sides via the large surrounding parking lot, allowing for easy movement around the property. The building has multiple potential entry points and open paved areas that could support staging. Mature trees along the perimeter may limit visibility from certain approaches but do not significantly obstruct overall site access. The layout allows relatively clear movement around the building for emergency vehicles.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking areas, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the building? Are there multiple points of entry into the main building? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to specific areas of the site? What is the primary use of the building (e.g., church, community center)? How do the surrounding roads and neighboring properties affect access or staging during an emergency response?
